_definition: Companies whose stock is no longer tradable because a takeover, squeeze-out, share exchange or delisting has COMPLETED. Same convention as data/delisted.json (Europe).

KOSE:A057050.price: Share exchange: 6.357104 Hyundai G.F. Holdings shares per Hyundai Home Shopping share
KOSE:A057050.reason: Became a wholly owned subsidiary of Hyundai G.F. Holdings through a comprehensive share exchange (completed end of June 2026; KOSPI delisting followed in July). Exact delisting date not pinned down in sources.

TSE:7250.reason: Management buyout: tender offer by CORE Co. (the president's acquisition vehicle) closed successfully on 26 Jan 2026; delisted after a share consolidation (Nagoya SE decision 24 Mar 2026, delisting date 13 Apr 2026).

TSE:7420.price: Share transfer into MIRAINI Holdings (no cash tender)
TSE:7420.reason: Became a wholly owned subsidiary of the newly formed joint holding company MIRAINI Holdings via a share transfer (business integration agreed 14 Oct 2025); TSE Prime listing cancelled at the end of March 2026 (one source says 27 Mar).

TSE:7923.reason: Taken private by CSRI5 (Enterprise Support Research Institute) via a tender offer (23 Dec 2025 - 16 Feb 2026) followed by a squeeze-out (demand for sale of shares); TSE delisting decided 27 Feb 2026, delisted 27 Mar 2026.

TSE:9927.reason: MBO tender offer by IAPF3 Co., Ltd. (IA Partners affiliate) succeeded (offer period 2026-02-16 to 2026-04-02), followed by share consolidation squeeze-out and delisting.

TSE:6489.price: Share transfer; exchange ratio not confirmed (Maezawa Kasei 7925 ratio 1.11 per JPX doc; Maezawa Industries ratio not confirmed, one site says 1:1)
TSE:6489.reason: Maezawa Industries became a wholly owned subsidiary of Maezawa Holdings via joint share transfer with Maezawa Kasei Industries (7925); Holdings technically listed on TSE Prime 2026-06-01.

ASX:SDI.reason: Scheme of arrangement; InnoXvest Dental Pty Ltd (subsidiary of Beijing Guoci Kebo Technology/Sinocera) acquired 100% of SDI; implemented 2026-07-06.

TSE:7105.reason: Tender offer by LVJ Holdings 2 (Japan Industrial Partners) succeeded 2026-02-18, followed by share consolidation squeeze-out; renamed Logisnext 2026-04-30.

TSE:3655.reason: Fujitsu acquired BrainPad via tender offer (success announced 2025-12-16) then share consolidation squeeze-out approved at shareholders meeting.

TSE:2180.reason: Akatsuki Inc. (3932) tender offer (2026-05-14 to 06-24, settlement 07-01) then share consolidation squeeze-out leaving Akatsuki and Next Field as sole shareholders.

TSE:6734.price: JPY 2,650 per share (tender offer; squeeze-out via demand for sale of shares)
TSE:6734.reason: Saxa Inc. (6675) acquired Newtech via tender offer (2025-12-19 to 2026-02-09, successful) followed by sell-out demand squeeze-out.

TSE:4974.reason: Takara Holdings (60.91% parent) tender offer (2026-02-16 to 04-06, successful) followed by share consolidation squeeze-out; delisted from TSE Prime.

TSE:7635.reason: MBO: UMK Co., Ltd. tender offer (2025-11-13 to 12-25, successful) followed by share consolidation squeeze-out approved at EGM scheduled 2026-03-03.

TSE:4333.price: n/a (share transfer; exchange ratio not seen)
TSE:4333.reason: Joint share transfer with Land Computer (3924) creating holding company Toranvia (Tranvia), which became parent of Toho System Science; Toranvia listed on TSE Prime 2026-04-01 (code 545A).
